question: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) is a welfare programme being administered by the _________.

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Rural Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)** is a **welfare programme** managed by the **Ministry of Rural Development** in India.
 
• The programme aims at providing **financial assistance** to the **elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities** in the form of pensions.
 
• The NSAP was launched on **15th August 1995** as a part of the **Public Assistance** for the poor section of the society.
 
• It is a component of the **National Policy for Social Assistance** for the poor and aims to ensure a minimum national standard for social assistance.
 
• The NSAP includes schemes like **Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)**, **Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)**, and **Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)**.
 
• These schemes are targeted towards individuals who live below the **poverty line** (BPL).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development**__

 __
 
• This ministry is responsible for the formulation and administration of the rules and regulations and laws relating to **women and child development** in India.
 
• It focuses on **empowerment of women** and **protection and development of children**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**__
 __
 
• This ministry is responsible for welfare, social justice, and empowerment of **marginalized sections** of society including **Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Senior Citizens, and Disabled Persons**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs**__
 
 
• This ministry is responsible for **internal security**, **border management**, **Centre-State relations**, and **administration of Union Territories**.
